items.raw_excerpt: Today, a word that will help you partake in a popular Swedish activity: discussing the weather.
items.summary_en: Brittsommar is a Swedish word for the short, calm time in midsummer. It starts in early June and ends in early July. The word is used to talk about a slow season in nature and a time to slow down in work.
items.summary_ko: 브릿쏘마르는 한여름 무렵의 짧고 잔잔한 시기를 가리키는 스웨덴 단어다. 6월 초에서 7월 초 사이를 뜻한다. 자연이 조용히 머무는 계절이자 일을 늦추는 때를 말할 때 쓴다.
items.title_en: Swedish Word of the Day: Brittsommar
items.title_original: Swedish word of the day: brittsommar

items.raw_excerpt: Today’s Danish word of the day, BMO, puts a youthful twist on an old classic.
items.summary_en: Young Danes now use BMO to mean a one month picture plan, like a cheap shared photo album. It is a short and funny name for the old long word. Danish has many short new words like this, and BMO is spreading fast.
items.summary_ko: 덴마크 젊은이는 BMO로 한 달 단위 사진 모음이나 구독을 가리킵니다. 예전의 긴 말 대신 더 짧고 익살스러운 이름입니다. 덴마크말에는 이런 짧은 신조어가 많아, BMO처럼 빠르게 퍼지고 있습니다.
items.title_en: Danish word of the day: BMO
items.title_original: Danish word of the day: BMO

items.raw_excerpt: Músico é autor de clássicos como a valsa Se ela perguntar e o choro Dois destinos. Também foi responsável por popularizar obras de outros compositores, como Abismo de Rosas, de Canhoto.
items.summary_en: Brazilian violin virtuoso Dilermando Reis would have turned 110 today. He wrote famous waltzes such as Se Ela Perguntar and Dois Destinos. He also helped make other composers' works known, including Abismo de Rosas by Canhoto.
items.summary_ko: 브라질의 유명한 이고음 연주가 일러만도 레이스가 오늘 110돌을 맞을 날이다. 그는 세라 페르구타르와 두이스 데스티노스 같은 왈츠를 작곡했다. 칸호토의 아비즈무 데 로자스처럼 다른 사람의 작품을 세상에 알린 역할도 했다.
items.title_en: Violin virtuoso Dilermando Reis turns 110 today
items.title_original: Violonista Dilermando Reis faria 110 anos hoje

items.raw_excerpt: Hyderabad experienced unexpected evening rain on September 22, 2026, disrupting rush hour and prompting a weather alert from IMD.
items.summary_en: Unexpected rain fell in Hyderabad on the evening of September 22, 2026. The rain slowed down the evening rush hour. India's weather office also issued a rain alert for the city.

items.title_en: Evening Rain Hits Hyderabad During Rush Hour
items.title_original: Rain lashes Hyderabad on September 22 evening rush hour

items.summary_en: Cyclists will ride bikes from Algoz this Sunday morning. The ride starts in the small town of Algoz in Portugal. It is a local outdoor event for the community.

items.raw_excerpt: Los 325 vecinos de La Granja de la Costera votarán si recuperan las campanas después de la queja de un residente que le impedía dormir
items.summary_en: The 325 residents of a small village near Valencia, Spain, will vote on whether the church bells that used to ring all night should come back. A neighbor who could not sleep at night filed a complaint, so the town decided to let the people decide.

items.raw_excerpt: Na Região Sul, chove com trovoadas no noroeste, norte e leste do Paraná, com possibilidade de chuvas isoladas no restante do estado e também no nordeste de Santa Catarina.
items.summary_en: Storms are expected in parts of southern Brazil. Rain is likely in northern, western, and eastern areas of Parana state. Isolated showers may also fall in Santa Catarina.

items.raw_excerpt: A six-year-old Chinese girl has set a new women's world record for solving a 3x3 Rubik's Cube in just over four seconds, state media reported.
items.summary_en: A six-year-old girl from China set a new women's world record for a 3x3 Rubik's Cube. She solved it in just over four seconds. State media reported the result.

items.raw_excerpt: Além de estrear o filme de abertura da mostra, Se Eu Fosse Vivo...Vivia, nesta terça-feira (22), escritora receberá o Troféu Horizonte.

items.raw_excerpt: How did a historic neighborhood in Mexico City come to be known as "Little Los Angeles?" MND Contributor Logan J. Gardner has more.
items.summary_en: Tabacalera is a small area in central Mexico City that people now call 'Little LA'. Many who were sent back from the United States live and work here. Small shops, food places, and a church line the narrow streets.
items.summary_ko: 멕시코시티 중심부의 작은 동네 타발케라는 이제 '리틀 엘에이'로 불린다. 미국에서 돌아온 사람들이 이곳에 살며 일을 한다. 이주민들이 만든 작은 가게, 식당, 교회가 좁은 거리를 채우고 있다.

items.raw_excerpt: Police are warning about children on electric motocross bikes capable of far higher speeds than the 25 km/h setting used on paths.
items.summary_en: Police in Iceland warn about children riding electric motocross bikes. These bikes can go much faster than the 25 km/h speed limit used on paths. Parents are asked to keep children away from roads with these bikes.

items.raw_excerpt: Los muros derrumbados del Castellet de Bernabé volverán a levantarse con técnicas tradicionales de piedra en seco. Llíria ha obtenido una subvención de cerca de 500.000 euros de la Di...
items.summary_en: A town in Valencia, Spain, got about 500,000 euros to rebuild the fallen walls of the Castellet de Bernabe. Workers will use dry stone techniques from long ago. The walls were built by Iberians, the people who lived in Spain long before Romans.

items.title_en: A village in Valencia rebuilds old stone walls the Iberian way

items.raw_excerpt: It won't take you a lifetime to master this simple phrase.
items.summary_en: This phrase means it took someone a long time to do something. It says the person spent what felt like their whole life on the task. The article explains how to use it in real life.
